confidence_notes: FX is from the RBA exchange rates overview and statistics pages (USD rate 0.6720 on 2026-11-18). Food and drink anchors come from one search of cost-of-living aggregators, mainly mylifeelsewhere (updated July 2026) and some older guides. Inexpensive meal, coffee and beer are fairly well supported. Mid-range meal for two is based on the A$120-150 guide figure, less the cost of drinks. Cocktail and wine are estimated from the beer price and the A$10-25 ranges in the guides. Accommodation was not searched. It is a holistic estimate from general knowledge of Melbourne, and I did not check any listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: Melbourne is compared with Sydney and other major Australian cities, which have similar high wages and heavily taxed alcohol. Hostel and hotel prices reflect typical year-round demand in the central business district and inner suburbs.
